newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 3.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were quoted steady to slightly higher on Monday in thin talks, traders said. Offers were scarce as sellers were sidelined, anticipating prices to climb in line with firmer cargo levels. "The market is waiting the cargo market to go up. Not many sellers are willing to offer," said one independent. The 180-cst grade fuel oil moved $1 per tonne higher.
